name: The Body Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals the Church as the Body of Christ, united under Christ who is its head, as emphasized in Ephesians 5:23 and Colossians 1:18. Believers, both Jew and Gentile, are members of this one body, each with distinct roles and functions that contribute to its growth and edification in love (Romans 12:4; Ephesians 3:6; Ephesians 4:16). The resurrection and exaltation of Christ to the right hand of God affirm His authority and central role in the life and unity of the Church (Ephesians 1:20).
